title: Hearty Crunchy Venezuelan Peppers Skillet
description: A sweet and crunchy one-pot Venezuelan dish featuring mixed peppers and lamination-puff, cooked to perfection on a raclette-grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to medium-high heat.
Slice the mixed bell peppers and onion into thin strips.
Roll out the lamination-puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut the pastry into small squares, about 2 inches per side.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced peppers and onion with olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Arrange the pastry squares on the preheated raclette-grill, leaving a small space between each square.
Spoon the pepper and onion mixture onto one half of each pastry square.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top of the pepper mixture.
Fold the other half of the pastry square over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Cook the pastry pockets for 5-7 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
